chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'The butter of the cow is a healing.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the healing properties of cow butter?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this concise hadith attributes the healing properties of cow butter (sumun al-baqar) to Imam Ali (peace be upon him), reflecting the early Islamic emphasis on natural remedies found in daily sustenance. Within Shia scholarly tradition, this narration is often cited to validate the medicinal benefits of dairy products, aligning with the broader Prophetic tradition of seeking cure in permissible foods.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The margarine of the cow is a healing’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from af-Nawfafiy from af-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘In ghee from cows there is a cure. 5 ”
